_approach: The tom-bounce cell of bh_tom_bounce escalated into a build: the low-mid-high tom conversation over the kick/clap frame thickens each bar and cascades downward into a final low-tom-plus-crash hit, with the open hat pulled back so the toms fully own the bounce heading into the drop. Ref: the tom-bounce approach (My Nu Leng "Masterplan"-style dark rollers), EDMProd's build-up guide. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
